Reese: Posting concise owners for the DR follow-ups from the postmortem. Reply one-liners: owner: action  ETA (date)  1-line blocker if any. Keep it terse.

Maya: Maya: owner: route-consistency test  action: CI job to diff routing tables across regions + auto-heal flag  ETA: 2026-04-11  blocker: needs platform CI access in us-west-2.

Owen: Owen: owner: snapshot-chain validator  action: post-snapshot integrity check + write base-snap-id metadata  ETA: 2026-04-08  blocker: storage API checksum field needed.

Priya: Priya: owner: dry-run ops coordination  action: reserve staging infra, ops checklist, war-room link  ETA: 2026-04-04  blocker: staging capacity tentative until Infra confirms.

Helena: Helena: owner: restore runbook overhaul  action: document single-AZ, partial-region, full-region restores + timed RTOs and rollback steps  ETA: 2026-04-06  blocker: needs reserved infra for timed drills.

Reese: Two recurring patterns to add tests for: (1) route table drift during burst autoscale, (2) restores slowed by incomplete incremental chains. Call out cross-team blockers.

Maya: I'll add a small stress harness in CI to simulate 4-6x burst scale and validate route reconciliation. Will attach logs in PR.

Owen: Validator will include a pre-promotion hook that fails if incremental chain is broken; PR will include sample diagnostics.

Priya: SchedulerBot: please create a tentative 3h window for the dry-run and add a stub playbook link.

SchedulerBot: SchedulerBot: Created tentative event "DR dry-run: regional failover" 2026-04-06 09:00-12:00 UTC. Playbook stub: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/dr-dry-run. Invitees: oncall, platform, storage, network.

OpsBot: OpsBot: Created ops checklist draft: https://docs.internal/ops/dr-checklist.md. Included blast-radius controls and rollback commands.

Reese: Owners: open PRs/tickets and paste links + exact ETA by EOD today. If you have cross-team blockers flag with :rotating_light:. We'll do a 20-min sync Mon to confirm.

Maya: Done  PR: https://git.internal/routing/pulls/140  risk: platform CI tokens INF-1102.

Owen: Done  PR: https://git.internal/storage/pulls/101  risk: storage rollout window.

Helena: Done  Ticket: RECOV-58  risk: staging infra reservation.

Priya: Thanks all  I'll update the postmortem tracker and ping owners weekly until closure. :white_check_mark:
